sources.sentence: Fairness cuts both ways in disputes between firms.

brief.meaningEn: The same principle of fair treatment should be considered for both sides.
brief.meaningZh: 公平對待的原則應同時適用於雙方。
brief.grammar: Fairness cuts both ways; a reciprocal application of cuts both ways, not the separate advantage/disadvantage sense in other contexts.
brief.register: Conversational principle in disputes; explain the relevant standard.
brief.boundaryZh: 同一原則不一定要求不同情況有相同結果，也不是說雙方必定犯相同錯誤。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能只要求對方守規則而替自己免除；仍須比較責任及實際影響。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用一致原則處理雙方，同時容許與情況相符的差別。

options.en: Applying the timing expectation to their own team as well.
options.zh: 把守時期待同樣用於自己小組。

options.en: Giving their own team an exception without considering the other side.
options.zh: 不考慮對方，便給自己小組例外。

options.en: Removing the deadline only for the team they criticise.
options.zh: 只替他們批評的小組取消限期。

options.en: Treating the other team’s delay as the only relevant responsibility.
options.zh: 把另一隊延誤當成唯一相關責任。

listening.explanationZh: we must too 把相同原則用於自己，不是只檢查對方。
listening.en: Fairness cuts both ways: if we expect the other team to meet the deadline, we must send our information on time too.
listening.zh: 公平原則適用雙方：如果要求另一隊守限期，我們也要準時交資料。

reply.promptEn: Why should our group also explain a delay if we ask the other group to do so?
reply.promptZh: 既然要求另一組解釋延誤，我們為甚麼也要解釋？

options.en: The same expectation should apply when our own work is late.
options.zh: 自己的工作遲了，也應適用相同期望。

options.en: Fairness cuts both ways, so we should follow the standard we ask of them.
options.zh: 公平原則適用雙方，所以我們應遵守要求對方的標準。

options.en: They need our update to plan their part of the project.
options.zh: 他們需要我們的更新，才能安排自己的部分。

options.en: Explaining our delay would make the coordination more balanced.
options.zh: 解釋自己的延誤可讓協調更平衡。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均合理解釋為何也要交代延誤；金句強調互相適用原則。

scene.promptZh: 你要求同伴先問才借器材，之後自己也想借對方器材。哪句最符合公平原則？

options.en: Fairness cuts both ways; I should ask before borrowing theirs too.
options.zh: 公平原則適用雙方；借對方器材前，我也應先問。

options.en: I can use their equipment first and explain my rule afterwards.
options.zh: 我可先用對方器材，之後才解釋自己的規則。

options.en: Their need to ask matters, but my own borrowing is a separate exception.
options.zh: 他們要先問很重要，但我的借用另作例外。

scene.explanationZh: 相同借用情況用相同先詢問原則，不應替自己另作例外。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 fairness cuts both ways 得出？

options.en: Both sides should consider the same relevant standard.
options.zh: 雙方都應考慮相同相關標準。

options.en: Different circumstances must always produce identical outcomes.
options.zh: 不同情況也永遠必須得到完全相同結果。

options.en: A group should examine its own responsibilities as well as the other side’s.
options.zh: 小組應檢視自己及對方的責任。

contrast.explanationZh: 原則一致仍可按不同情況合理調整，不等於所有結果完全相同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴問：「我們要求別人預先通知改期，但自己這次沒通知，要怎樣處理？」哪句最合適？

options.en: Fairness cuts both ways. We should acknowledge our missed update and tell them the new time now.
options.zh: 公平原則適用雙方。我們應承認漏了更新，現在告訴對方新時間。

options.en: Check their last late message first and delay explaining our own change.
options.zh: 先查對方上次遲覆的訊息，押後解釋自己的改期。

options.en: Call our change an informal adjustment so we can avoid applying the notification rule.
options.zh: 把自己的更改稱為非正式調整，避開通知規則。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認自己的同類責任及立即補通知，是公平原則的具體應用。

speaking.en: Fairness cuts both ways; we should meet the standard we expect from others.
speaking.zh: 公平原則適用雙方；我們應符合對別人的要求。
speaking.promptZh: 你想提醒小組對自己也用同一原則。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社團要求借書人準時還書，但社團答應寄出的參考資料遲了。用一至兩句英文指出雙方責任，並提出補救。

examples.en: Fairness cuts both ways. We expect borrowers to return books on time, so we should explain our own delay and send the materials now.
examples.zh: 公平原則適用雙方。我們要求借書人準時還書，所以也應解釋自己的延誤，現在寄出資料。

examples.en: Fairness cuts both ways, so the club should follow its own timing expectations and update the people waiting for the materials.
examples.zh: 公平原則適用雙方，所以社團也應遵守自己的時間期待，向等候資料的人更新消息。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以要求還書及自己寄資料的責任作具體比較，承認延誤並補救；不要求不同過失有同一處分。

takeaways.en: Fairness cuts both ways when both teams depend on timely updates.
takeaways.zh: 雙方小組都依靠及時更新時，公平原則適用雙方。

takeaways.en: Fairness cuts both ways, so we should examine our part in the misunderstanding.
takeaways.zh: 公平原則適用雙方，所以我們應檢視自己在誤會中的責任。

sources.sentence: A small firm should not get off lightly after serious harm.

brief.meaningEn: Receive only a mild punishment or consequence, often less severe than expected or deserved.
brief.meaningZh: 只受到輕微處分或後果，常比預期或應有的輕。
brief.grammar: get off lightly; got off lightly in the past; this lesson focuses on consequences after wrongdoing.
brief.register: Conversational idiom; a critical judgement needs context.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課不是無罪或沒有發生過失，也不表示受處分較輕便必須有不當關係。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要交代過失及後果，區分輕微處分、完全免責和公正與否的進一步判斷。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述後果較輕，並以資料評估是否合適。

options.en: The consequences were mild in relation to the repeated breaches.
options.zh: 相對反覆違規，後果較輕。

options.en: He was found never to have broken the rules.
options.zh: 他被確認從未違規。

options.en: He was banned from using the equipment for the rest of the year.
options.zh: 他在餘下一年被禁止使用器材。

options.en: The warning had been issued before any breach occurred.
options.zh: 警告在任何違規發生前已發出。

listening.explanationZh: 簡短警告及不限制借用支持處分輕微，不是證明沒有違規。
listening.en: After ignoring the shared-equipment rules several times, he got off lightly with a short warning and no restriction on borrowing.
listening.zh: 幾次不理會共用器材規則後，他只受到較輕處分：簡短警告，仍可借用。

reply.promptEn: Why do people think the response to the repeated rule-breaking was lenient?
reply.promptZh: 大家為甚麼認為對反覆違規的處理較寬鬆？

options.en: The organiser gave a reminder but imposed no further restriction.
options.zh: 主辦者給了提醒，沒有進一步限制。

options.en: He seems to have got off lightly compared with the disruption caused.
options.zh: 相比造成的干擾，他似乎只受到較輕處分。

options.en: The warning was brief despite several earlier incidents.
options.zh: 之前已發生幾次，但警告仍很簡短。

options.en: People affected by the delays expected the organiser to address the pattern more directly.
options.zh: 受延誤影響的人期望主辦者更直接處理反覆問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均提供寬鬆評價的理由；金句不等於他完全沒有責任。

scene.promptZh: 有人反覆遲還工具，令工作延誤，最後只收到口頭提醒；同伴覺得後果比預期輕。哪句貼切？

options.en: He got off lightly with a verbal reminder.
options.zh: 他只收到口頭提醒，處分較輕。

options.en: He was cleared of responsibility because every tool was returned early.
options.zh: 因每件工具都提早歸還，他獲確認沒有責任。

options.en: He received the long borrowing ban that the others had expected.
options.zh: 他受到其他人預期的長期借用禁令。

scene.explanationZh: 只口頭提醒及比預期輕支持 idiom，不是清白或已受較重處分。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜只憑 get off lightly 得出？

options.en: The person faced a relatively mild consequence.
options.zh: 那個人面對相對輕微的後果。

options.en: The person cannot have done anything wrong.
options.zh: 那個人不可能做錯任何事。

options.en: The speaker may be comparing the consequence with a more severe expectation.
options.zh: 說話者可能把後果與較重預期比較。

contrast.explanationZh: 後果輕微不等於沒有過失；本課正用於違規後的處理。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「後果很輕，我們可直接說處理一定不公平嗎？」哪句較準確？

options.en: He may have got off lightly, but we should check the circumstances and the full response before judging fairness.
options.zh: 他可能只受到較輕處分，但判斷公平前應查情況及完整處理。

options.en: Demand the harshest available penalty before hearing why the organiser chose a warning.
options.zh: 未聽主辦者為何選警告，就要求最重處分。

options.en: Compare only the length of the warning and leave out the harm or any agreement to repair it.
options.zh: 只看警告長短，不看傷害或補救協議。

dialogue.explanationZh: 輕重可先描述，公平與否仍要看過失、影響及完整後果，不只選最重或看表面。

speaking.en: She got off lightly, though we should understand the full circumstances before judging.
speaking.zh: 她只受到較輕處分，但判斷前應了解完整情況。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述後果，同時保留查證需要。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：活動助手兩次漏鎖儲物櫃，最後只收到提醒，你覺得後果較輕，但還不知道是否另有補救安排。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The helper seems to have got off lightly with a reminder. We should ask whether any other steps were agreed to prevent another incident.
examples.zh: 助手似乎只收到提醒，處分較輕。我們應問是否另有議定步驟，防止再發生。

examples.en: She got off lightly compared with what we expected, but we need to know the full response before calling it unfair.
examples.zh: 跟我們預期相比，她只受到較輕處分，但說不公平前仍要了解完整處理。

writing.selfCheckZh: 區分輕微後果及公平判斷，保留未知補救安排；不把輕處分當成沒有犯錯。

takeaways.en: He got off lightly with a warning after the repeated breaches.
takeaways.zh: 反覆違規後，他只受到警告這項較輕處分。

takeaways.en: Getting off lightly does not remove the need to repair the harm.
takeaways.zh: 只受到較輕處分，不會免除補救傷害的需要。

sources.sentence: The seller promised to put things right.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 242, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She promised to make it right with her colleague.

brief.meaningEn: Take action to correct a mistake or repair the harm caused.
brief.meaningZh: 採取行動改正錯誤，或補救造成的傷害。
brief.grammar: put things right / make it right; both mean take concrete action to correct a mistake or repair harm. It refers to the specific wrong, not a vague promise of perfection.
brief.register: Common spoken expression; the right action depends on the specific problem.
brief.boundaryZh: 不只是說對不起，也不保證所有感受立即恢復；要有實際補救行動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 應先問清問題及受影響者需要，不能用自己的善意取代有效處理。
brief.outcomeZh: 能提出與錯誤對應的具體補救，並確認是否解決需要。

options.en: Sending the corrected certificates after acknowledging the mistake.
options.zh: 承認錯誤後寄出更正證書。

options.en: Apologising but leaving the certificates unchanged.
options.zh: 道歉卻不改證書。

options.en: Explaining why the names were omitted without contacting those affected.
options.zh: 解釋為何漏名，卻不聯絡受影響者。

options.en: Asking recipients to accept the incorrect names to avoid reprinting.
options.zh: 為免重印，請收件者接受錯誤姓名。

listening.explanationZh: by 後點明更正證書是實際行動，不只解釋或道歉。
listening.en: The organiser apologised for the missing names and put things right by sending corrected certificates to everyone affected.
listening.zh: 主辦者為漏掉姓名道歉，並寄出更正證書給受影響的人，補救錯誤。

reply.promptEn: What will you do after sending the wrong timetable?
reply.promptZh: 寄錯時間表後，你會怎樣處理？

options.en: I will contact the group with the corrected time and apologise for the confusion.
options.zh: 我會把正確時間通知小組，並為混亂道歉。

options.en: I will put things right by sending a clear correction to everyone who received it.
options.zh: 我會向每位收件者發清楚更正，補救錯誤。

options.en: I will check who may have changed their plans and help them with the update.
options.zh: 我會查誰可能因此改了安排，幫他們更新。

options.en: I will replace the old notice and confirm the new details with the organiser.
options.zh: 我會換掉舊通告，與主辦者確認新資料。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都是針對錯誤的合理補救；金句明示把更正送到受影響者。

scene.promptZh: 你誤把同學名字寫錯在海報上，發現後換上正確版本，並通知已收到舊版的人。哪句合適？

options.en: You are taking practical steps to put things right.
options.zh: 你正採取實際步驟補救。

options.en: You have only explained the mistake and left the old poster in use.
options.zh: 你只解釋錯誤，仍讓舊海報使用。

options.en: You are asking the student to use the wrong name for this event.
options.zh: 你正請同學在這次活動使用錯誤姓名。

scene.explanationZh: 更正及通知舊版收件者直接修復問題，不是只解釋或遷就錯誤。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 put things right 得出？

options.en: An action can correct a mistake or repair harm.
options.zh: 行動可改正錯誤或補救傷害。

options.en: An apology alone necessarily solves every practical problem.
options.zh: 單靠道歉必定解決每個實際問題。

options.en: The remedy should respond to what went wrong.
options.zh: 補救應回應出錯的事情。

contrast.explanationZh: 道歉可重要，但仍可能需要退款、更正或重新安排等實際行動。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友寄錯場地位置，已說對不起，卻還未寄正確地址，問下一步怎樣做。哪句最合適？

options.en: Let us put things right by sending the correct address now and checking who needs help getting there.
options.zh: 我們現在寄正確地址，並查誰需要到場協助，來補救吧。

options.en: Send a longer explanation of how the error happened before sharing the corrected address.
options.zh: 先更長篇解釋出錯原因，之後才分享正確地址。

options.en: Update only the organiser’s own copy and assume everyone else will find the change.
options.zh: 只改主辦者自己的版本，假設其他人會找到更改。

dialogue.explanationZh: 受影響者需要準確地址及可能的協助，先處理實際需要；只解釋或只改自己版本不足。

speaking.en: I want to put things right by correcting the information and contacting everyone affected.
speaking.zh: 我想透過更正資料，並聯絡每位受影響的人，來補救錯誤。
speaking.promptZh: 你想提出具體而對應問題的補救。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社團錯收了部分同學重複報名費，你們想退款並確認帳目。用一至兩句英文承認錯誤及說明補救。

examples.en: We will put things right by refunding the duplicate payments and checking the records with each affected student.
examples.zh: 我們會退還重複款項，並與每位受影響同學核對紀錄，補救錯誤。

examples.en: Let us put things right: contact the students, explain the mistake and return the extra fees.
examples.zh: 我們補救吧：聯絡同學、解釋錯誤，並退回多收費用。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把補救連到退款及核對帳目，不是只道歉或要求同學接受多收。

takeaways.en: The seller offered to put things right by replacing the damaged item.
takeaways.zh: 賣家提出更換損壞物品，補救問題。

takeaways.en: After sending the wrong timetable, the organiser made it right by contacting every participant and booking another room.
takeaways.zh: 主辦人發錯時間表後，逐一聯絡參加者並另訂房間，以補救錯誤。

lessons.titleEn: the punishment fits the scale of the offence

target.pattern: \bthe punishment (?:should |must )?fits? the scale of (?:the offence|the harm)\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A fair policy ensures the punishment fits the scale of the offence.

brief.meaningEn: The consequence is proportionate to how serious the wrongdoing or harm is.
brief.meaningZh: 後果與過失或傷害的嚴重程度相稱。
brief.grammar: the punishment fits the scale of the offence; should fit with a modal; scale needs a clear reference such as harm or offence.
brief.register: Natural proportionality pattern in policy discussion; this lesson uses fictional club examples, not advice about current law.
brief.boundaryZh: 相稱不等於越重越公平，也不是只按人的身分、聲望或負責人有多生氣。
brief.misconceptionZh: 應看過失及實際影響，不能只因同一類規則就忽略程度差異。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明相稱原則，並辨認程度、身分及個人情緒的不同。

options.en: The seriousness and pattern of the wrongdoing.
options.zh: 過失的嚴重程度及是否反覆。

options.en: Only how angry the organiser feels that afternoon.
options.zh: 只看主辦者當天下午有多生氣。

options.en: Whether the person is more popular than the others.
options.zh: 看那個人是否比其他人受歡迎。

options.en: The assumption that every case causes identical harm.
options.zh: 假設每個個案都造成相同傷害。

listening.explanationZh: 反覆嚴重損壞與首次輕微錯誤是明確程度比較，不是人氣或情緒。
listening.en: In the fictional club policy, the punishment fits the scale of the offence: repeated serious damage receives a stronger response than a minor first mistake.
listening.zh: 在虛構社團政策中，處分與過失程度相稱：反覆嚴重損壞，比首次輕微錯誤有較強後果。

reply.promptEn: Why should the club compare the damage before deciding the consequence?
reply.promptZh: 社團為甚麼要先比較損壞，再決定後果？

options.en: The response should reflect how serious each incident was.
options.zh: 回應應反映每次事件有多嚴重。

options.en: We need to ensure the punishment fits the scale of the harm.
options.zh: 我們要確保處分與傷害程度相稱。

options.en: A small first mistake and repeated major damage may need different responses.
options.zh: 首次小錯與反覆大損壞可能需要不同回應。

options.en: The impact on the people using the equipment is relevant to the decision.
options.zh: 對器材使用者的影響，與決定有關。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋比較損壞的理由；金句不是一律重罰，而是看相稱。

scene.promptZh: 虛構社團比較首次輕微遲還與反覆損壞工具，再按影響決定不同後果。哪句合適？

options.en: The punishment should fit the scale of the offence.
options.zh: 處分應與過失程度相稱。

options.en: The most popular member should receive the lighter response regardless of the damage.
options.zh: 不論損壞程度，最受歡迎組員都應有較輕後果。

options.en: The organiser should choose the response from their mood rather than the impact.
options.zh: 主辦者應按自己心情，而非影響選擇回應。

scene.explanationZh: 題設看過失影響及模式，不是身分或個人心情。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解最不符合 the punishment fits the scale of the offence？

options.en: The response is related to the seriousness of what happened.
options.zh: 回應與事件嚴重程度有關。

options.en: The harsher response is automatically the fairer one in every case.
options.zh: 每次都自動以較重後果為較公平。

options.en: The extent of the harm helps inform the decision.
options.zh: 傷害程度有助判斷後果。

contrast.explanationZh: 相稱需要比較實際程度，不是一律越重越好。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我今天很生氣，所以應比平常罰重一點。」哪句較準確？

options.en: The punishment should fit the scale of the offence, so let us check the harm rather than use today’s frustration as the measure.
options.zh: 處分應與過失程度相稱，所以先查傷害，不把今天的氣憤當尺度。

options.en: Choose the consequence now while the feeling is strongest and examine the details afterwards.
options.zh: 情緒最強時先選後果，之後才看細節。

options.en: Compare the person’s popularity with other members before considering what was damaged.
options.zh: 未看損壞甚麼，先比較那個人與其他成員的人氣。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先看過失及傷害，才能考慮相稱；個人情緒及人氣不是可靠尺度。

speaking.en: The punishment should fit the scale of the offence, not simply reflect our frustration.
speaking.zh: 處分應與過失程度相稱，不只反映我們的氣憤。
speaking.promptZh: 你想說清相稱原則及不應採用的尺度。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：虛構學校辯論比賽中，一位學生首次發言短暫超時，另一位多次打斷對手。主辦者想先比較對比賽的影響，再決定相稱處分。用一至兩句英文說明原則及比較方法。

examples.en: The punishment should fit the scale of the offence. The organiser should compare one brief overrun with repeatedly interrupting opponents before deciding.
examples.zh: 處分應與過失程度相稱。主辦者決定前，應比較一次短暫超時與反覆打斷對手。

examples.en: We should check whether the punishment fits the scale of the harm in this debate contest, rather than give the same penalty without comparing the impact.
examples.zh: 這次辯論比賽中，我們應查處分是否與傷害程度相稱，而非未比較影響就給相同處分。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把相稱原則連到短暫超時與反覆打斷的實際影響，先比較再決定；不自行指定真實賽事處分，也不按人氣或情緒判斷。

takeaways.en: A fair process asks whether the punishment fits the scale of the offence.
takeaways.zh: 公平流程會考慮處分是否與過失程度相稱。

takeaways.en: The punishment should fit the scale of the harm rather than the organiser’s mood.
takeaways.zh: 處分應與傷害程度相稱，而不是配合主辦者心情。

sources.sentence: Technology firms often cluster together near universities.

brief.meaningEn: Form a group or be situated close together in one area.
brief.meaningZh: 形成一組，或位置靠近，聚集在同一地區。
brief.grammar: people/businesses cluster together near/around + place; cluster is the verb and together reinforces grouping.
brief.register: Natural verb-plus-adverb combination; source calls it a phrasal verb, while Oxford and Cambridge present it under cluster with an adverb/preposition.
brief.boundaryZh: 靠近不保證同一公司、相同意見或一定合作；需與位置分散區分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可以有合作原因，但不能只因相鄰便斷言每家企業共用管理。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述空間聚集及地點，保留位置與組織關係的分別。

listening.promptZh: 店舖的位置有甚麼特點？

options.en: They were situated close to one another in the same area.
options.zh: 它們位於同一地區，互相靠近。

options.en: They were spread across distant towns with no nearby shops.
options.zh: 它們分散在相距很遠的城鎮，附近沒有其他店。

options.en: They had all merged into one shop under the same manager.
options.zh: 它們全都合併成同一經理管理的一間店。

options.en: They offered only online services and had no physical location.
options.zh: 它們只提供網上服務，沒有實體地點。

listening.explanationZh: near the station 和比較方便描述位置聚集，不是合併或沒有實體店。
listening.en: Several repair shops clustered together near the station, making it easy for customers to compare their services.
listening.zh: 幾間維修店聚集在車站附近，讓顧客方便比較服務。

reply.promptEn: Why is that area convenient for comparing repair services?
reply.promptZh: 那個地區為甚麼方便比較維修服務？

options.en: Several shops are only a short walk from one another.
options.zh: 幾間店互相只隔一小段步程。

options.en: Repair businesses cluster together around the station.
options.zh: 維修商戶聚集在車站周圍。

options.en: Customers can visit more than one provider without travelling far.
options.zh: 顧客不用走很遠便可看幾個服務商。

options.en: There are different specialists within the same small district.
options.zh: 同一小區內有不同專門店。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均解釋位置方便比較；金句不表示商戶屬同一公司。

scene.promptZh: 幾家工作室都搬到舊工廠大樓及附近街道，各自經營但彼此很近。哪句最準確？

options.en: The studios cluster together in the old industrial area.
options.zh: 工作室聚集在舊工業區。

options.en: The studios are located in distant districts rather than near one another.
options.zh: 工作室分布在遠離彼此的不同地區。

options.en: The studios have replaced their independent management with one shared owner.
options.zh: 工作室以同一業主取代各自管理。

scene.explanationZh: 靠近且各自經營是空間聚集，不能改說分散或共用管理。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜只憑 cluster together 得出？

options.en: The businesses are close to one another.
options.zh: 商戶互相靠近。

options.en: They must all share one owner and agree on every policy.
options.zh: 它們必定同一業主，且每項政策都一致。

options.en: They form a concentrated group in an area.
options.zh: 它們在一地區形成集中群組。

contrast.explanationZh: 位置靠近不必有共同業權或政策；原片語說的是聚集。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這幾家店聚在一起，問一家就等於知道全部價錢？」哪句較準確？

options.en: They cluster together, but they may operate independently, so we should compare their prices.
options.zh: 它們聚集一起，但可能各自經營，所以應比較價錢。

options.en: Use the first shop’s quotation as the price for the whole area without checking the others.
options.zh: 不查其他店，就把首家報價當成整區價錢。

options.en: Choose a provider from the shared address alone before asking what each shop specialises in.
options.zh: 未問各店專長，只按同一地點選服務商。

dialogue.explanationZh: 聚集方便比較，卻不等於報價及專長一致；應分別了解。

speaking.en: The workshops cluster together near the college but remain independently run.
speaking.zh: 工作坊聚集在學院附近，但仍各自經營。
speaking.promptZh: 你想同時說清空間聚集及獨立運作。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你發現幾間書店都在車站旁的小街，各有不同選書，打算逐家看看。用一至兩句英文描述位置及比較方法。

examples.en: The bookshops cluster together near the station. I can visit each one to compare their different selections.
examples.zh: 書店聚集在車站附近。我可以逐間看看，比較不同選書。

examples.en: Several bookshops cluster together on the same street, but I still want to find out what each offers.
examples.zh: 幾間書店聚集在同一條街，但我仍想了解各店提供甚麼。

writing.selfCheckZh: 保留同區靠近的位置，並分別了解各店；不能只因聚集便說同價、同主或同類書。

takeaways.en: Small studios often cluster together near shared facilities.
takeaways.zh: 小工作室常聚集在共用設施附近。

takeaways.en: The stalls clustered together around the square without becoming one business.
takeaways.zh: 攤位聚集在廣場周圍，但沒有變成同一商戶。

lessons.titleEn: casts a very large business shadow
lessons.titleZh: 商業影響遠超本身規模

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The port city casts a very large business shadow across the region.
sources.expression: casts a very large business shadow

brief.meaningEn: Have commercial influence extending well beyond a place’s physical size.
brief.meaningZh: 一個地方的商業影響力遠超本身的實際規模。
brief.grammar: a city casts a large business shadow across a region; cast is also the past tense.
brief.register: A contextual metaphor, not a fixed measure of economic size; explain the channels of influence.
brief.boundaryZh: shadow 在此不是陰暗名聲，也不能單憑比喻推算人口、產值或市場份額。
brief.misconceptionZh: 必須由商業聯繫支持影響力；地方面積大不等於商業作用大。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體貿易或企業聯繫解釋跨地區商業影響。

options.en: The port influences trade beyond its own small area.
options.zh: 港口影響超出本身小範圍的貿易。

options.en: The port occupies more land than the neighbouring towns combined.
options.zh: 港口佔地比鄰鎮加起來更多。

options.en: Trade through the port has stopped and the shops have found other routes.
options.zh: 經港口的貿易已停止，店舖找到其他路線。

options.en: Its importance is confined to businesses inside the port boundary.
options.zh: 其重要性局限於港口範圍內的商戶。

listening.explanationZh: 鄰鎮依靠經港口運送的貨物，支持跨地區影響，不是在量面積或描寫衰退。
listening.en: The small port casts a very large business shadow: shops in several neighbouring towns depend on the goods passing through it.
listening.zh: 這個小港口的商業影響力很大：幾個鄰鎮的店舖依靠經此運送的貨物。

reply.promptEn: Why does that small port matter to businesses in the surrounding towns?
reply.promptZh: 那個小港口為甚麼對附近城鎮的商戶重要？

options.en: Many of their supplies pass through it.
options.zh: 他們很多貨物都經那裏運送。

options.en: It casts a large business shadow across the area through its trading links.
options.zh: 它透過貿易聯繫，對區內產生廣泛商業影響。

options.en: Its shipping services connect local shops with distant suppliers.
options.zh: 其航運服務把當地商戶與遠方供應商連起來。

options.en: Changes there can affect delivery times for several towns.
options.zh: 那裏的變化可影響幾個城鎮的交貨時間。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均交代具體商業作用；金句的 shadow 是影響範圍。

scene.promptZh: 一個小鎮的批發市場向多個城市供貨，影響遠超小鎮面積。哪句合適？

options.en: The town casts a large business shadow through its wholesale market.
options.zh: 小鎮透過批發市場產生廣泛商業影響。

options.en: Its commercial role is limited to serving households within the town.
options.zh: 其商業作用只限服務鎮內住戶。

options.en: The town must occupy more land than the cities it supplies.
options.zh: 小鎮佔地必定比它供貨的城市更多。

scene.explanationZh: 供應多個城市支持廣泛商業作用；不能從供貨範圍推論土地大小。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解不宜只憑 casts a large business shadow 得出？

options.en: Its commercial influence reaches beyond its immediate location.
options.zh: 其商業影響超出直接所在地。

options.en: The metaphor gives an exact figure for its share of regional trade.
options.zh: 這個比喻提供區域貿易份額的確切數字。

options.en: Trade links may explain why a small place matters elsewhere.
options.zh: 貿易聯繫可解釋小地方為何對別處重要。

contrast.explanationZh: 比喻描述影響，不能取代貿易數據；實際程度仍需查證。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴做港口報告，想只用面積圖解釋它為何影響鄰鎮的商戶。哪句建議最合適？

options.en: Show the delivery links as well; they explain how it casts a large business shadow beyond its size.
options.zh: 也展示運貨聯繫；它們解釋港口如何產生超出本身規模的商業影響。

options.en: Rank the ports by land area and use that ranking as the explanation of their trading influence.
options.zh: 按佔地排名，並用這個排名解釋各港口的貿易影響。

options.en: Include only shops inside the port boundary and leave out the towns receiving its goods.
options.zh: 只包括港口範圍內商店，略去接收貨物的城鎮。

dialogue.explanationZh: 要解釋跨地區影響，應連到貨物及商戶聯繫；面積排名或只看港內都漏掉重點。

speaking.en: The town casts a large business shadow because its market supplies shops across the region.
speaking.zh: 小鎮的商業影響廣泛，因為其市場向區內各地商店供貨。
speaking.promptZh: 你想用供貨聯繫解釋小地方的廣泛商業作用。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：面積不大的城市設有主要物流中心，多個外地工廠依靠它安排送貨。用一至兩句英文解釋影響，避免只談土地大小。

examples.en: The city casts a large business shadow because factories elsewhere rely on its logistics centre to organise deliveries.
examples.zh: 這個城市產生廣泛商業影響，因為外地工廠依靠其物流中心安排送貨。

examples.en: Although the city is small, it casts a very large business shadow through the delivery network serving factories across the region.
examples.zh: 雖然城市很小，卻透過服務區內各地工廠的運貨網絡，產生廣泛商業影響。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以外地工廠、物流及運貨解釋商業影響，不把比喻當作面積或精確產值。

takeaways.en: The port casts a large business shadow through the suppliers that depend on it.
takeaways.zh: 港口透過依靠它的供應商，產生廣泛商業影響。

takeaways.en: A small city can cast a large business shadow when its services support firms elsewhere.
takeaways.zh: 小城市的服務支援外地企業時，也能產生廣泛商業影響。

sources.sentence: The firm opened an office to gain a foothold in Asia.

brief.meaningEn: An initial secure position from which to develop activity in Asian markets.
brief.meaningZh: 在亞洲市場取得可進一步發展的初步穩固位置。
brief.grammar: gain/establish a foothold in Asia; the same pattern can name a market or sector.
brief.register: Business metaphor based on a firm place to put a foot; distinguish entry from dominance.
brief.boundaryZh: 初步立足不表示已主導亞洲，也不能只憑租辦公室便確認有穩定客源。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需有起步活動或客戶作支持，再看如何發展，不能把小規模進入說成成熟領先。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述市場起步位置及合理的下一步。

listening.promptZh: 公司在亞洲達到甚麼階段？

options.en: It has an initial customer base from which it can develop.
options.zh: 它已有可進一步發展的初步客戶基礎。

options.en: It has replaced its European business with Asian sales.
options.zh: 它以亞洲銷售取代了歐洲業務。

options.en: It is only considering entry and has not yet obtained any clients there.
options.zh: 它仍只考慮進入，尚未取得當地客戶。

options.en: It already dominates the markets throughout Asia.
options.zh: 它已主導整個亞洲的市場。

listening.explanationZh: 首批固定客戶支持初步立足；大部分銷售仍在歐洲，不是亞洲已主導或取代歐洲。
listening.en: The firm gained a foothold in Asia after securing its first regular clients in Singapore, though most of its sales still came from Europe.
listening.zh: 公司取得新加坡首批固定客戶後，在亞洲初步立足，但大部分銷售仍來自歐洲。

reply.promptEn: What has the firm achieved by winning its first regular clients in Singapore?
reply.promptZh: 取得新加坡首批固定客戶後，公司達成了甚麼？

options.en: It has a starting customer base for developing the business there.
options.zh: 它已有可用來發展當地業務的起步客戶基礎。

options.en: It has gained a foothold in Asia.
options.zh: 它已在亞洲初步立足。

options.en: It has moved beyond researching the market to serving repeat customers.
options.zh: 它已由研究市場，進展到服務回頭客。

options.en: It now has practical experience with a small group of local clients.
options.zh: 它現在有服務一小群當地客戶的實際經驗。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均符合初批固定客戶的進展；金句沒有聲稱市場領導地位。

scene.promptZh: 小公司剛在亞洲取得幾位持續下單的客戶，正計劃逐步擴展。哪句準確？

options.en: It has gained a foothold in Asia and can build from there.
options.zh: 它已在亞洲初步立足，可從這裏繼續發展。

options.en: It has completed its expansion across every Asian market.
options.zh: 它已完成在每個亞洲市場的擴展。

options.en: It is still at the stage of considering whether to seek its first client there.
options.zh: 它仍在考慮是否尋找當地首位客戶。

scene.explanationZh: 持續客戶是起點，不是全部擴展完成，也不是尚未找客戶。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 a foothold in Asia 得出？

options.en: There is an initial position that may support further development.
options.zh: 已有可能支持進一步發展的初步位置。

options.en: The business must already be the regional market leader.
options.zh: 企業必定已是區域市場領導者。

options.en: The expression alone does not quantify the firm’s market share.
options.zh: 單靠這個表達不能量化公司的市場份額。

contrast.explanationZh: 立足是初步位置，不是領導地位的同義詞；仍須看實際客戶及市場數據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把首批亞洲客戶寫成「已主導亞洲」，問怎樣改得準確。哪句最合適？

options.en: Say it has gained a foothold in Asia, then describe the first clients and the next stage of growth.
options.zh: 說它在亞洲初步立足，再交代首批客戶及下一階段發展。

options.en: Use regional leader as the headline and put the small client base only in the footnote.
options.zh: 標題用區域領導者，只在註腳提及小型客戶基礎。

options.en: Describe the sales as merely a plan because the client base is still small.
options.zh: 因客戶基礎仍小，就把這些銷售只寫成計劃。

dialogue.explanationZh: 既承認已有業務，也保留初步階段；誇大主導或抹去真實進展都不準確。

speaking.en: The company has gained a foothold in Asia, but it still needs to develop its local relationships.
speaking.zh: 公司已在亞洲初步立足，但仍要發展當地關係。
speaking.promptZh: 你想同時承認起步成績及後續需要。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你的文具品牌首次獲兩間亞洲商店固定訂貨，想逐步增加合作店舖。用一至兩句英文說明現況及下一步。

examples.en: Our brand has gained a foothold in Asia through regular orders from two shops. We now want to build relationships with more retailers.
examples.zh: 我們的品牌透過兩間店的固定訂單，在亞洲初步立足。我們現在想與更多零售商建立關係。

examples.en: The two shops have given us a foothold in Asia, and we plan to learn from their feedback before expanding further.

brief.meaningEn: A centre connecting commercial activity across a surrounding region.
brief.meaningZh: 連繫周邊地區商業活動的中心。
brief.grammar: a regional business hub; serve as/become/develop into a hub for trade or services.
brief.register: Natural business and geography collocation; hub suggests concentrated connections, not merely a large population.
brief.boundaryZh: regional 有區域範圍，不等於世界中心；business hub 也不是單指交通站或居民多。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需要企業、物流、服務等商業連繫作支持，不能只看城市面積。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體跨地區商業活動描述樞紐作用。

options.en: It connects commercial activity from several nearby cities.
options.zh: 它連繫幾個鄰近城市的商業活動。

options.en: It serves only the daily needs of its own residents.
options.zh: 它只服務本鎮居民的日常需要。

options.en: It has become the centre of trade for the entire world.
options.zh: 它已成為全世界的貿易中心。

options.en: It functions as a passenger stop without business services.
options.zh: 它只作客運站，沒有商業服務。

listening.explanationZh: 企業跨城市使用貨倉、銀行、商展，支持區域商業中心；範圍並非全球。
listening.en: The town became a regional business hub as firms from neighbouring cities used its warehouses, banks and trade fairs.
listening.zh: 鄰近城市的企業使用這個鎮的貨倉、銀行及商展，讓它成為區域商業樞紐。

reply.promptEn: Why do nearby firms use this town as a base?
reply.promptZh: 附近企業為甚麼以這個鎮作基地？

options.en: It links them with storage, finance and trading events in one place.
options.zh: 它在同一地方連繫倉儲、融資及商貿活動。

options.en: It serves as a regional business hub for the surrounding cities.
options.zh: 它為周邊城市提供區域商業樞紐的作用。

options.en: Its services help companies coordinate work across the area.
options.zh: 其服務幫企業協調區內工作。

options.en: Suppliers and customers from several towns meet there regularly.
options.zh: 幾個城鎮的供應商與客戶定期在那裏見面。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均說明企業基地的商業連繫；金句的 regional 沒有誇大為全球。

scene.promptZh: 一個城市集中物流、商業服務及區內企業會面活動，連繫周邊城鎮的貿易。哪句合適？

options.en: The city acts as a regional business hub.
options.zh: 這個城市作為區域商業樞紐。

options.en: The city’s commercial services are restricted to a single residential street.
options.zh: 這個城市的商業服務局限於一條住宅街。

options.en: The city is merely a transport stop with no role in regional trade.
options.zh: 這個城市只是交通站，沒有參與區域貿易。

scene.explanationZh: 物流、服務及企業會面形成商貿網絡，超出單一住宅街或純客運。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項資料最不足以支持 regional business hub 這個描述？

options.en: Companies from several nearby cities use its finance and logistics services.
options.zh: 幾個鄰近城市的企業使用其金融及物流服務。

options.en: The town has a large population, with no information about commercial links.
options.zh: 鎮的人口很多，但沒有商業聯繫資料。

options.en: Regional suppliers regularly meet buyers at its trade events.
options.zh: 區內供應商定期在其商貿活動與買家會面。

contrast.explanationZh: 居民多本身不足以證明商業樞紐，還要有集中服務及跨地區聯繫。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴只以居民人數多，就在報告稱某鎮是商業樞紐，問還應加甚麼證據。哪句最合適？

options.en: Show how firms use its services across the area to support calling it a regional business hub.
options.zh: 展示區內企業如何使用其服務，支持把它稱為區域商業樞紐。

options.en: Add more population comparisons and leave out the companies using its services.
options.zh: 增加人口比較，略去使用當地服務的企業。

options.en: Replace regional with global to make the description sound more important before checking the links.
options.zh: 未查聯繫，先把區域改成全球，讓描述更重要。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需要商業服務及企業聯繫證據；人口或更大的形容範圍不能代替。

speaking.en: Its finance and logistics services help the city function as a regional business hub.
speaking.zh: 金融及物流服務幫這個城市發揮區域商業樞紐作用。
speaking.promptZh: 你想把稱號連到實際服務。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一個城市每月舉辦商展，附近地區的小企業到那裏找供應商及安排運貨。用一至兩句英文描述其作用。

examples.en: The city has become a regional business hub where small firms meet suppliers and arrange deliveries at regular trade fairs.
examples.zh: 這個城市已成為區域商業樞紐，小企業在定期商展與供應商會面，並安排運貨。

examples.en: Regular trade fairs and delivery services support the city’s role as a regional business hub for nearby firms.
examples.zh: 定期商展及運貨服務，支持這個城市為附近企業提供區域商業樞紐的作用。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用商展、供應商及運貨解釋區域商業作用，保留附近地區的範圍。

takeaways.en: The city developed into a regional business hub for finance and trade.
takeaways.zh: 這個城市發展成金融及貿易的區域商業樞紐。

takeaways.en: A regional business hub connects firms with services beyond their own town.
takeaways.zh: 區域商業樞紐把企業與本鎮以外的服務連起來。

brief.meaningEn: Preserve one or several possible future choices or routes of access rather than closing them now.
brief.meaningZh: 保留一個或多個未來選擇或參與途徑，而非現在就把它們關閉。
brief.grammar: Keep more doors open or let more doors stay open describes preserving several future options. Leave the door open for something and keep the/that door wide open for someone preserve one particular option or access route; wide emphasizes access, not a guarantee of a place. This differs from opening a new door to create an opportunity.
brief.register: Figurative option-preservation pattern. A course adviser may discuss several future paths; a community workshop organiser may discuss keeping one beginner route available. Neither expression means leaving a physical door unlocked.
brief.boundaryZh: 保留一條現有途徑與開創新機會不同；門繼續敞開不保證人人獲得名額。若保留多條路，也要說明實際入門條件。
brief.misconceptionZh: 保留選擇不等於無限期拖延決定；維持新手途徑亦須核實課程仍有合適名額與支援。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分保留多個未來選擇與維持一條已有的參與途徑，並避免把途徑當成成果保證。

listening.promptZh: 修讀兩類課的目的是甚麼？

options.en: To preserve more than one relevant future direction.
options.zh: 保留不止一個相關未來方向。

options.en: To confirm a final decision to avoid all design work.
options.zh: 確認最終決定，避開所有設計工作。

options.en: To postpone checking the entry requirements for either direction.
options.zh: 押後查閱兩個方向的入學要求。

options.en: To replace training with a promise of a job in interactive media.
options.zh: 以互動媒體工作的承諾取代培訓。

listening.explanationZh: 兩類課連到兩個可能方向，是保留選擇，不是已決定避開設計或免除培訓。
listening.en: Taking both design and computing keeps more doors open while I decide whether to work in visual design or interactive media.
listening.zh: 修讀設計及電腦課，在我決定從事視覺設計或互動媒體前，保留較多選擇。

reply.promptEn: Why are you keeping both design and computing in your study plan for now?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼暫時在學習計劃中保留設計及電腦課？

options.en: Both subjects support paths I am still considering.
options.zh: 兩科都支援我仍在考慮的路向。

options.en: They help me keep more doors open until I choose a direction.
options.zh: 它們幫我在選定方向前，保留更多選擇。

options.en: I want experience in each area before specialising.
options.zh: 我想先有兩方面經驗，再選專門方向。

options.en: The combination is relevant to both visual design and interactive media.
options.zh: 這個組合與視覺設計及互動媒體都有關。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均合理解釋暫時保留兩科；金句不表示永不決定。

scene.promptEn: A community repair workshop has long offered an introductory session that requires no previous tool experience. Its organisers consider replacing that session with an advanced class, but decide to retain one beginner session each month. Which sentence best describes the decision?
scene.promptZh: 社區維修工作坊一直設有毋須先有工具使用經驗的入門課。主辦方考慮以進階班取代它，但最後決定每月保留一節新手班。哪句最能描述這個決定？

options.en: They keep the door wide open for newcomers by retaining a session that needs no prior experience.
options.zh: 他們保留毋須先有經驗的課堂，讓新來者仍有參與途徑。

options.en: Keeping an introductory session means every newcomer is guaranteed a place, regardless of capacity.
options.zh: 保留入門課就代表不論名額限制，每位新來者都保證有位。

options.en: The workshop now requires previous tool experience before any newcomer can join.
options.zh: 工作坊現在要求每位新來者先有工具使用經驗，才可參加。

scene.explanationZh: 保留入門課令新來者仍有參與途徑，但不保證所有人都有名額；也沒有改成一律要求先有經驗。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解不宜由 keep more doors open 得出？

options.en: An action may preserve several future possibilities.
options.zh: 一項行動可保留幾個未來可能方向。

options.en: Every option will remain available without checking its requirements.
options.zh: 不用查要求，每個選項都會一直可用。

options.en: The benefit depends on which choices the action actually supports.
options.zh: 好處取決於該行動實際支援哪些選擇。

contrast.explanationZh: 保留選擇需要對應要求，不是不用查條件的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想保留兩個升學方向，卻打算只憑課程名稱選科，不查先修條件。哪句建議最好？

options.en: Check both sets of requirements so your subjects really keep more doors open.
options.zh: 查兩邊要求，讓選科確實保留更多選擇。

options.en: Take whichever courses sound broadest and check the required subjects after applications close.
options.zh: 選聽來最廣泛的課，申請截止後才查必修科。

options.en: Keep adding optional subjects before checking whether the required ones fit your timetable.
options.zh: 未查必修科能否排入時間表，就繼續加選修科。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先比對必需條件，才能確定保留兩路；課名廣或科目多並不等於符合要求。

speaking.en: I want to keep more doors open, so I am checking which subjects both courses require.
speaking.zh: 我想保留更多選擇，所以正查兩個課程需要哪些科目。
speaking.promptZh: 你想把保留選擇連到具體查證。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你仍考慮博物館教育或學校教學，想透過溝通訓練及不同實習了解兩者。用一至兩句英文解釋計劃。

examples.en: Communication training could help me keep more doors open while I explore museum education and school teaching. I also want experience in both settings.
examples.zh: 溝通訓練可在我探索博物館教育及學校教學時，幫我保留更多選擇。我也想在兩種環境取得經驗。

examples.en: I hope to keep more doors open by developing communication skills and trying placements in a museum and a school before specialising.
examples.zh: 我希望先發展溝通技巧，並嘗試在博物館及學校實習，以保留更多選擇，再選專門方向。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出兩個考慮方向，以及共通技巧與實習如何支援探索；不是保證兩邊都獲取錄。

takeaways.en: Flexible training can help graduates keep more doors open.
takeaways.zh: 彈性培訓可幫畢業生保留更多選擇。

takeaways.en: Keeping the door wide open for beginners preserves a route into the workshop without promising every applicant a place.
takeaways.zh: 為新手保留參與途徑，不等於承諾每位申請者都有名額。

sources.sentence: Clear writing is one of the skills that travel well.

brief.meaningEn: Abilities that remain useful across different jobs, settings or places.
brief.meaningZh: 轉換工作、環境或地方後，仍然有用的能力。
brief.grammar: skills that travel well; singular a skill that travels well; explain which new settings share the need.
brief.register: Figurative transferable-skills wording; skills do not physically travel.
brief.boundaryZh: 可轉用不等於無須調整，也不保證每份工作的專門要求都相同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 應指出共通用途，而不是只看有沒有出差或旅行經驗。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以兩種環境的共同需要，說明技巧如何轉移。

options.en: They can be useful in more than one kind of work.
options.zh: 它們可在不止一類工作中有用。

options.en: They replace the specialist training needed for teaching.
options.zh: 它們取代教學所需的專門培訓。

options.en: They are useful only when the worker is travelling overseas.
options.zh: 它們只在工作者出國旅行時有用。

options.en: They lose their usefulness as soon as the job title changes.
options.zh: 職位名稱一改，它們便失去用處。

listening.explanationZh: 兩份工作都需要聆聽及解釋，支持轉用；though 明確保留專門培訓需要。
listening.en: Listening carefully and explaining ideas clearly are skills that travel well from customer service to teaching, though each job needs its own training.
listening.zh: 細心聆聽及清楚解釋想法，是從客戶服務轉到教學仍有用的技巧，但每份工作仍需本身的培訓。

reply.promptEn: Why do you practise explaining ideas clearly when you have not chosen a career yet?
reply.promptZh: 你還沒選職業，為甚麼練習清楚解釋想法？

options.en: Many kinds of work require people to understand one another.
options.zh: 很多類工作都需要人們互相理解。

options.en: Clear explanation is one of the skills that travel well between roles.
options.zh: 清楚解釋是其中一種能跨職位運用的技巧。

options.en: It could help me in both teamwork and work with customers.
options.zh: 它可幫我合作，也可用於服務客戶。

options.en: I want a useful foundation while I explore different jobs.
options.zh: 探索不同工作時，我想先有實用基礎。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋共通技巧的價值；金句不以實際旅程作條件。

scene.promptZh: 學生把社團練到的清楚寫作，用在科學報告及實習電郵，並按讀者調整語氣。哪句貼切？

options.en: Clear writing is one of the skills that travel well across these settings.
options.zh: 清楚寫作是能跨這些環境運用的技巧之一。

options.en: Her writing skill is useful only in the club where she first learnt it.
options.zh: 她的寫作技巧只在最初學會的社團有用。

options.en: She can use the identical tone for every report and email without considering the reader.
options.zh: 她不用考慮讀者，可在每份報告及電郵用完全相同語氣。

scene.explanationZh: 共通技巧可轉用，仍要按讀者及任務調整；不是原環境限定或照搬格式。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 skills that travel well 得出？

options.en: A skill may support more than one job or setting.
options.zh: 技巧可支援不止一份工作或環境。

options.en: The same skill removes the need to learn any role-specific knowledge.
options.zh: 同一技巧免除學習任何職位專門知識的需要。

options.en: The way a skill is applied may still need adjustment.
options.zh: 運用技巧的方式仍可能需要調整。

contrast.explanationZh: 可轉移能力與專門知識可並存；聆聽或寫作不能取代一切培訓。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把零售聆聽經驗帶到課堂助理工作，卻打算直接照用商店話術。哪句建議最好？

options.en: Listening is one of the skills that travel well, but adapt your questions to pupils and the classroom.
options.zh: 聆聽是能跨環境運用的技巧之一，但要按學生及課堂調整問題。

options.en: Keep the sales questions unchanged so your experience looks consistent across the two roles.
options.zh: 保留銷售問題不變，讓經驗在兩份工作看來一致。

options.en: Leave listening out of your application because it was first developed in retail.
options.zh: 因聆聽最初在零售工作中發展，就在申請略去它。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認共通能力，同時調整應用；照搬話術或否定原經驗都忽略可轉用的性質。

speaking.en: Clear writing is one of the skills that travel well, even when the audience and format change.
speaking.zh: 即使讀者及格式改變，清楚寫作仍是能跨環境運用的技巧之一。
speaking.promptZh: 你想說清共通技巧與需要調整的部分。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在義工工作學會耐心聆聽，現在想用在學生支援實習，同時接受學校的專門培訓。用一至兩句英文解釋。

examples.en: Patient listening is one of the skills that travel well from volunteering to student support. I will still need the school’s specific training.
examples.zh: 耐心聆聽是能從義工工作轉用於學生支援的技巧之一。我仍需要學校的專門培訓。

examples.en: I have developed skills that travel well, such as patient listening, and I want to adapt them to the needs of pupils during my placement.
examples.zh: 我已發展能跨環境運用的技巧，例如耐心聆聽；實習時我想按學生需要調整運用。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出原經驗、新用途及專門培訓或調整需要；不可寫成毋須再學。

takeaways.en: Listening and teamwork are skills that travel well between many roles.
takeaways.zh: 聆聽與團隊合作，是能在很多職位之間轉用的技巧。

takeaways.en: Clear writing is a skill that travels well, but each audience needs a suitable approach.
takeaways.zh: 清楚寫作是能跨環境運用的技巧，但每類讀者仍需合適方法。

lessons.titleZh: 助力進一步發展的起點

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The internship became a launch pad for her career.

brief.meaningEn: A starting experience or position that helps someone move towards further achievement.
brief.meaningZh: 能幫人邁向進一步成就的起步經驗或位置。
brief.grammar: a launch pad for a career/project; serve as/become/use something as a launch pad.
brief.register: Conventional figurative launch metaphor; launchpad is also written as one word, but this lesson practises launch pad.
brief.boundaryZh: 是有幫助的起點，不是最終目的或成功保證；需解釋如何通往下一步。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能只因某段經驗較早便叫 launch pad，應有技巧、聯繫或機會等推動作用。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以起步經驗與後來進展的因果連繫使用比喻。

options.en: It provided experience that helped her reach a later opportunity.
options.zh: 它提供經驗，幫她取得後來的機會。

options.en: It marked the end of her interest in journalism.
options.zh: 它標誌她對新聞工作的興趣終結。

options.en: It was merely earlier in time, with no link to the course application.
options.zh: 它只是時間較早，與課程申請沒有關係。

options.en: It replaced the need for her to apply or show any work.
options.zh: 它取代了申請或展示作品的需要。

listening.explanationZh: 訪問作品幫申請成功，構成推動下一步的起點；不是只排時間或免除申請。
listening.en: The local radio placement became a launch pad for her career: the interviews she recorded helped her win a place on a journalism course.
listening.zh: 本地電台實習成為她事業的起點：錄製的訪問幫她取得新聞課程學額。

reply.promptEn: Why was the radio placement useful beyond the weeks you spent there?
reply.promptZh: 電台實習為甚麼不只在實習幾週內有用？

options.en: The recordings gave me work to show when applying for further training.
options.zh: 錄音給我申請進修時可展示的作品。

options.en: It became a launch pad for my next stage in journalism.
options.zh: 它成為我在新聞領域下一階段的起點。

options.en: The experience introduced me to people who later offered guidance.
options.zh: 經驗讓我認識後來給我指導的人。

options.en: I learnt interview skills that helped me prepare a stronger application.
options.zh: 我學到訪問技巧，幫我準備更好的申請。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋實習如何支援下一步；金句不是完成所有發展。

scene.promptZh: 短期設計實習讓學生完成作品集，之後用它申請到較長培訓。哪句合適？

options.en: The internship served as a launch pad for further training.
options.zh: 實習成為進一步培訓的起點。

options.en: The internship was the final stage, after which she stopped pursuing design.
options.zh: 實習是最後階段，之後她不再追求設計。

options.en: The later training had no connection with the portfolio from the internship.
options.zh: 後來培訓與實習作品集沒有關係。

scene.explanationZh: 作品集連到後來培訓機會，支持助力進展的起點。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以把一次經驗稱為 a launch pad？

options.en: It develops work that helps secure the next opportunity.
options.zh: 它產生可幫人取得下一機會的作品。

options.en: It happens first, but offers no identified support for what follows.
options.zh: 它最先發生，卻沒有指出對後來進展有何幫助。

options.en: It builds useful contacts for a later project.
options.zh: 它建立有利後來項目的聯繫。

contrast.explanationZh: 時間較早本身不足；比喻需要對後來進展的推動作用。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友把實習叫「事業起點」，報告卻只列日期，問如何讓意思清楚。哪句建議最好？

options.en: Explain which skills or work made it a launch pad for the next opportunity.
options.zh: 解釋哪些技巧或作品，讓它成為下一個機會的起點。

options.en: Add more dates but leave out how the placement helped the later application.
options.zh: 增加日期，略去實習如何幫後來申請。

options.en: Describe the placement as the final goal rather than showing what it enabled next.
options.zh: 把實習寫成最終目標，而不說它帶來甚麼下一步。

dialogue.explanationZh: 要呈現推動作用，不只早晚或把起點當終點。

speaking.en: The placement was a launch pad for my career because it helped me build a portfolio.
speaking.zh: 實習成為我事業的起點，因為它幫我建立作品集。
speaking.promptZh: 你想說明這段起步經驗怎樣帶來下一步。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生在社區藝術活動首次策展，從中取得作品紀錄及導師聯繫，打算申請藝術管理課程。用一至兩句英文解釋這段經驗的作用。

examples.en: The community exhibition could be a launch pad for her studies in arts management, giving her work to show and contacts to learn from.
examples.zh: 社區展覽可成為她修讀藝術管理的起點，讓她有作品展示，也有可請教的人脈。

examples.en: She hopes to use the exhibition as a launch pad for further training by including the project records in her application.
examples.zh: 她希望在申請加入項目紀錄，讓展覽成為進一步培訓的起點。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把策展紀錄或聯繫連到課程申請；保留打算及可能性，不把未有結果寫成已獲取錄。

takeaways.en: The small exhibition became a launch pad for a larger creative project.
takeaways.zh: 小展覽成為更大創作項目的起點。

takeaways.en: She used the placement as a launch pad for further study.
takeaways.zh: 她以實習作進一步學習的起點。

brief.meaningEn: Achieve considerable success or progress in an activity or career.
brief.meaningZh: 在活動或事業取得相當成就或進展。
brief.grammar: someone can/could/will go far; has gone far; explain qualities and context.
brief.register: Conventional success metaphor; also has a literal distance sense, which this lesson distinguishes.
brief.boundaryZh: 稱讚潛力或描述進展，不是精確距離、職銜或成功保證。
brief.misconceptionZh: 努力及好習慣可支持判斷，仍需機會及持續學習；不以暫時失敗否定潛力。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體表現支持對未來成長的有保留稱讚。

options.en: She shows potential for considerable progress in design.
options.zh: 她展現在設計上大有進展的潛力。

options.en: She has already reached the final stage of her career.
options.zh: 她已到達事業最後階段。

options.en: She needs to travel a long distance to reach the design classroom.
options.zh: 她要走很遠才能到設計課室。

options.en: She should stop changing her work in response to feedback.
options.zh: 她應停止按意見修改作品。

listening.explanationZh: in design 及接受意見的線索支持成功潛力；could 不是已完成事業。
listening.en: Her tutor thinks she could go far in design because she accepts feedback and steadily improves her work.
listening.zh: 導師認為她可在設計上取得長遠成就，因為她接受意見，持續改進作品。

reply.promptEn: Why do you think this young designer has a promising future?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼認為這位年輕設計師前途有希望？

options.en: She keeps learning from criticism and improving her work.
options.zh: 她持續從批評學習，改進作品。

options.en: She could go far with that combination of curiosity and discipline.
options.zh: 憑好奇心及自律的結合，她可取得長遠成就。

options.en: Her recent projects show steady progress and careful thought.
options.zh: 她近期項目顯示穩定進步及細心思考。

options.en: She asks useful questions and follows through on suggestions.
options.zh: 她提出有用問題，也會落實建議。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都有具體潛力理由；金句用 could，沒有把未來說成保證。

scene.promptZh: 新手編輯反覆檢查資料，願意學習，作品逐步進步。導師想稱讚其發展潛力。哪句合適？

options.en: You could go far if you keep learning with this care.
options.zh: 如果繼續這樣用心學習，你可取得長遠成就。

options.en: Your current work shows that you no longer need any practice.
options.zh: 你現時作品顯示你已不再需要練習。

options.en: Your improvement means next year’s award is already certain.
options.zh: 你的進步表示明年得獎已成定局。

scene.explanationZh: 願意學及逐步進步支持有條件的潛力判斷，不表示毋須練習，也不足以保證明年得獎。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句的 go far 是實際距離，而不是成就？

options.en: The coach thinks the committed player could go far in the sport.
options.zh: 教練認為這位投入的球員可在運動上取得長遠成就。

options.en: We cannot go far along this path before reaching the river.
options.zh: 沿這條路走不了多遠，就會到河邊。

options.en: Her willingness to learn has helped her go far in research.
options.zh: 她願意學習，幫她在研究上取得長遠成就。

contrast.explanationZh: 沿路到河邊有實際行走距離；運動或研究的語境才指發展成就。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想鼓勵新手作家，但說「你肯定下年得大獎」沒有根據。哪句更合適？

options.en: You could go far if you keep developing your ideas and learning from feedback.
options.zh: 如果持續發展想法，並從意見學習，你可取得長遠成就。

options.en: Keep the prize prediction and remove the examples of how the writing has improved.
options.zh: 保留得獎預測，刪掉寫作如何進步的例子。

options.en: Judge the whole future from the most recent rejection rather than the wider progress.
options.zh: 只按最近一次被拒，而非整體進步判斷全部前景。

dialogue.explanationZh: 有保留的潛力稱讚，連到持續學習；無根據預言或單次拒絕都不足判斷未來。

speaking.en: You could go far if you keep learning from feedback and improving your work.
speaking.zh: 如果持續從意見學習，改進作品，你可取得長遠成就。
speaking.promptZh: 你想給有根據而非保證式的鼓勵。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：新隊員每次訓練都準備充分，也主動問如何改進。用一至兩句英文鼓勵其未來發展，同時保留持續努力的條件。

examples.en: You could go far in this sport if you keep preparing carefully and asking how to improve.
examples.zh: 如果繼續細心準備，也問怎樣改進，你可在這項運動取得長遠成就。

examples.en: With that willingness to learn, you could go far. Keep building your skills through regular practice.
examples.zh: 憑這份學習意願，你可取得長遠成就。繼續透過定期練習發展技巧吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 稱讚準備及學習意願，使用 could 或條件；不要憑空保證獎項、年分或職位。

takeaways.en: A curious student who keeps learning could go far.
takeaways.zh: 持續學習而有好奇心的學生，可取得長遠成就。

takeaways.en: Her care with details has helped her go far in her chosen field.
takeaways.zh: 她注重細節，幫她在所選領域取得長遠成就。

brief.meaningEn: Pursue the status of a position, especially when the label matters more than the work.
brief.meaningZh: 追求職位帶來的地位，尤其把名銜看得比實際工作重要。
brief.grammar: chase a title; chasing a title rather than developing skills; chased in the past.
brief.register: Contextual figurative pursuit; title can also mean a sporting championship, so read the context.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是每個想升職的人都只愛名銜；需有忽略責任或內容的線索。
brief.misconceptionZh: 本課是職位地位，不是爭奪球賽冠軍；追求名銜不等於實際願意承擔工作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分職銜、工作內容及相關責任，以證據描述動機。

listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持說話者的判斷？

options.en: His interest centres on the label rather than the responsibilities.
options.zh: 他的興趣集中於名銜，而非責任。

options.en: He has carefully compared the duties and chosen the role for its daily work.
options.zh: 他仔細比較職責，因日常工作而選這個職位。

options.en: He is preparing to win a sports championship.
options.zh: 他正準備贏得體育冠軍。

options.en: He has declined the title while taking on its responsibilities.
options.zh: 他拒絕名銜，卻承擔相關責任。

listening.explanationZh: 只問總監稱號及少關心職責，是地位重於內容的線索；seemed 保留判斷語氣。
listening.en: He seemed to be chasing a title: he asked when he could be called director but showed little interest in the duties or training.
listening.zh: 他似乎一味追求職銜：只問何時可被稱為總監，卻不太關心職責或培訓。

reply.promptEn: Why are you cautious about his interest in becoming director?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼對他想當總監這件事有所保留？

options.en: He asks about the label but has not asked what the job involves.
options.zh: 他問名銜，卻沒問工作涉及甚麼。

options.en: He seems to be chasing a title rather than considering the responsibilities.
options.zh: 他似乎一味追求職銜，而非考慮責任。

options.en: His questions focus on status, not the training the role requires.
options.zh: 他的問題集中地位，而非職位需要的培訓。

options.en: He has not yet explained what attracts him to the actual work.
options.zh: 他尚未解釋實際工作哪方面吸引他。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理表達保留；金句沒有斷言所有晉升動機相同。

scene.promptZh: 學生想當社團主席，反覆問名牌及介紹頭銜，卻不肯了解會議與協調工作。哪句有根據？

options.en: He seems to be chasing a title rather than learning about the role.
options.zh: 他似乎一味追求職銜，而非了解職位。

options.en: His questions show a detailed interest in the chair’s daily responsibilities.
options.zh: 他的問題顯示對主席日常責任有細緻興趣。

options.en: He has rejected the title in order to focus on supporting others.
options.zh: 他已拒絕名銜，專注支援別人。

scene.explanationZh: 名牌及介紹頭銜配合不願了解工作，才支持這個判斷，不單憑想當主席。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項資料最不足以說某人 is chasing a title？

options.en: He asks about status while dismissing questions about the duties.
options.zh: 他問地位，卻不重視職責問題。

options.en: She applies for promotion after carefully considering the work and responsibilities.
options.zh: 她仔細考慮工作及責任後，申請晉升。

options.en: He wants the new label but refuses to discuss its required tasks.
options.zh: 他想要新名銜，卻拒談必要工作。

contrast.explanationZh: 有考慮內容的晉升申請，本身不足以指只追名銜；要有地位重於內容的證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友只說想升職，同伴便斷定他只愛名銜，問你是否同意。哪句較準確？

options.en: We need to ask what attracts him to the work before saying he is chasing a title.
options.zh: 說他一味追求職銜前，應先問實際工作哪方面吸引他。

options.en: Use the promotion application alone as enough evidence about his motives.
options.zh: 單靠晉升申請就當作動機的充分證據。

options.en: Compare the prestige of the job titles without asking what responsibilities he wants.
options.zh: 不問他想承擔甚麼責任，只比較職銜聲望。

dialogue.explanationZh: 升職意願不足判斷動機；應了解對工作內容的興趣，不只看名銜聲望。

speaking.en: I want to understand the work rather than chase a title for its status.
speaking.zh: 我想了解工作，而非為地位追求職銜。
speaking.promptZh: 你想說清選職位時重視內容。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你獲邀競選社團領袖，想先了解時間及協調責任，而非只為履歷上的名銜參選。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: I do not want to chase a title just for my CV. I want to understand the time commitment and the work involved before deciding.
examples.zh: 我不想只為履歷追求職銜。我想先了解時間投入及涉及的工作，再決定。

examples.en: Rather than chasing a title, I want to find out whether I can take on the coordination responsibilities properly.
examples.zh: 我想先了解能否妥善承擔協調責任，而非一味追求職銜。

writing.selfCheckZh: 保留了解責任才決定的動機，不把想當領袖一概說成虛榮，也不提供未有的競選結果。

takeaways.en: He stopped chasing a title and started looking for work he wanted to do.
takeaways.zh: 他不再一味追求職銜，開始找自己想做的工作。

takeaways.en: Before chasing a title, she considered the responsibilities it would bring.
takeaways.zh: 追求職銜之前，她先考慮它帶來的責任。

brief.meaningEn: Take on greater responsibility or make a stronger effort when it is needed.
brief.meaningZh: 有需要時承擔更多責任，或加大努力。
brief.grammar: step up to help/lead; someone steps up when a role needs filling; this lesson is intransitive, not step up production.
brief.register: Common phrasal verb in teamwork and responsibility; authority and capacity still matter.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是單指正式升職，也不要求一個人包辦；可以主動協調及尋求支援。
brief.misconceptionZh: 承擔要切合權責及能力，不能未溝通就接管別人的決定。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述有人在需要時補上責任，並提出可行支援。

options.en: She took greater responsibility while coordinating with the appropriate person.
options.zh: 她承擔更多責任，同時與合適的人協調。

options.en: She received a permanent promotion that had already been agreed.
options.zh: 她獲得一項早已議定的永久晉升。

options.en: She left the volunteers without a plan until the coordinator returned.
options.zh: 她讓義工沒有計劃，等統籌員回來。

options.en: She cancelled the arrangement rather than helping organise it.
options.zh: 她取消安排，而非幫忙統籌。

listening.explanationZh: stepped up to organise 表示主動補上責任；核對計劃也顯示協調，不等於永久升職。
listening.en: When the coordinator was absent, Mia stepped up to organise the volunteers and checked the plan with the deputy before they began.
listening.zh: 統籌員缺席時，Mia 主動承擔安排義工的責任，開始前也與副手核對計劃。

reply.promptEn: Why did the event continue smoothly when the coordinator was away?
reply.promptZh: 統籌員不在時，活動為甚麼仍順利進行？

options.en: Mia took responsibility for organising the volunteers.
options.zh: Mia 承擔了安排義工的責任。

options.en: Mia stepped up and helped the group follow an agreed plan.
options.zh: Mia 主動承擔責任，幫小組依議定計劃行事。

options.en: The deputy and Mia checked the arrangements before the group began.
options.zh: 副手與 Mia 在小組開始前核對安排。

options.en: Someone filled the coordination gap instead of leaving the roles unclear.
options.zh: 有人補上統籌空缺，而非讓分工不明。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均合理解釋活動得以繼續；金句重點是主動補位，不是任命新職位。

scene.promptZh: 組長臨時缺席，成員先與老師確認分工，再主動協調展示，不等別人處理。哪句合適？

options.en: She stepped up to coordinate the presentation.
options.zh: 她主動承擔協調展示的責任。

options.en: She waited for the absent leader without helping the group plan.
options.zh: 她等待缺席組長，沒有幫小組安排。

options.en: She was formally appointed to the permanent leadership role before this happened.
options.zh: 事情發生前，她已正式獲任命為永久領導。

scene.explanationZh: 臨時主動協調就是 step up；沒有永久任命的資料。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不符合本課 step up 的用法？

options.en: A member volunteers to coordinate when the team needs help.
options.zh: 團隊需要協助時，成員主動統籌。

options.en: Someone avoids an agreed responsibility and leaves it unassigned.
options.zh: 有人避開議定責任，任由它沒有負責人。

options.en: A colleague makes an extra effort during a difficult period.
options.zh: 同事在困難時期加大努力。

contrast.explanationZh: 本課指補上責任或努力，不是避開已同意的工作。

dialogue.promptZh: 組長缺席，朋友想幫忙，卻不知道可作哪些決定。哪句建議最合適？

options.en: You can step up by coordinating the agreed tasks and checking any new decisions with the deputy.
options.zh: 你可主動協調議定工作，並向副手確認新決定，來承擔責任。

options.en: Change the whole plan first and ask the deputy afterwards whether you had authority.
options.zh: 先改整個計劃，之後才問副手自己有沒有權限。

options.en: Wait silently for the leader while the group continues without knowing its tasks.
options.zh: 小組仍不知道工作時，默默等組長。

dialogue.explanationZh: 主動承擔可配合確認權責；未授權大改或任由分工不明都不足。

speaking.en: I can step up to coordinate the agreed tasks while checking the decisions that need approval.
speaking.zh: 我可主動協調議定工作，同時確認哪些決定需要批准。
speaking.promptZh: 你想主動幫忙，也顧及權責。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區活動負責人臨時請假，你願意接手當天聯絡，但要先與副手核對名單及安排。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: I can step up to handle today’s messages, but I will check the contact list and arrangements with the deputy first.
examples.zh: 我可主動承擔今天的聯絡工作，但會先與副手核對聯絡名單及安排。

examples.en: I am willing to step up while the organiser is away. Let us confirm the plan before I contact the volunteers.
examples.zh: 主辦者不在時，我願意主動承擔責任。聯絡義工前，先確認計劃吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 主動接聯絡責任，同時核對授權及安排；不把臨時補位寫成永久升職。

takeaways.en: A colleague stepped up to coordinate the work when help was needed.
takeaways.zh: 需要協助時，一位同事主動承擔統籌責任。

takeaways.en: You can step up without taking every decision away from the team.
takeaways.zh: 你可主動承擔責任，而不必把團隊每個決定都包辦。

sources.sentence: A company shows its true colours when a product fails.

brief.meaningEn: Reveal genuine character or attitudes, especially when a situation tests them.
brief.meaningZh: 顯露真正性格或態度，尤其在受到考驗時。
brief.grammar: show its/one’s true colours; showed in the past; British spelling colours.
brief.register: Conventional character metaphor, often critical but context may reveal helpful values too.
brief.boundaryZh: 是從行為看性格，不是改標誌顏色；一次線索也未必足以評價整家公司。
brief.misconceptionZh: 應交代受考驗時的實際回應，不能只靠宣傳口號判斷。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體回應支持對真實態度的有保留評價。

options.en: Its response to a problem conflicted with its caring public image.
options.zh: 它處理問題的回應，與關心客戶的公開形象不符。

options.en: Its advertising colours changed after a planned redesign.
options.zh: 計劃重新設計後，廣告配色改了。

options.en: It responded promptly and gave the help requested.
options.zh: 它迅速回應，提供所求協助。

options.en: The customers have not yet asked it for any support.
options.zh: 客戶尚未向它要求任何支援。

listening.explanationZh: 廣告與實際求助回應對比，支持態度顯露，不是視覺配色或未有求助。
listening.en: The company showed its true colours when a fault appeared: despite its caring adverts, it ignored customers’ requests for help.
listening.zh: 故障出現時，公司顯露真面目：雖然廣告說關心客戶，卻不理會求助。

reply.promptEn: Why did the customers lose trust after the fault appeared?
reply.promptZh: 故障出現後，客戶為甚麼失去信任？

options.en: The company’s response did not match its caring promises.
options.zh: 公司的回應不符合關心客戶的承諾。

options.en: It showed its true colours by ignoring people who needed help.
options.zh: 它不理會需要協助的人，顯露了真面目。

options.en: Repeated requests for support went unanswered.
options.zh: 反覆提出的支援請求得不到回應。

options.en: Customers saw a gap between the public message and the actual service.
options.zh: 客戶看見公開訊息與實際服務的差距。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均解釋信任受損；金句要連到實際行為，而非只聽口號。

scene.promptZh: 團隊平時說重視合作，出問題時卻把責任全推給新成員，拒看自己的決定。哪句有根據？

options.en: The team showed its true colours in the way it handled the problem.
options.zh: 團隊處理問題的方式，顯露了真面目。

options.en: The team demonstrated its usual support by openly reviewing its own decisions.
options.zh: 團隊公開檢視自身決定，展現一貫支持。

options.en: The problem only concerned changing the team’s visual identity.
options.zh: 問題只涉及改變團隊的視覺形象。

scene.explanationZh: 口頭合作與實際推責的反差，支持真實態度顯露，不是外觀設計。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以證明某組織 has shown its true colours？

options.en: Its reaction to a serious complaint exposes a gap between its values and conduct.
options.zh: 它回應嚴重投訴的方式，暴露價值口號與行為的差距。

options.en: It changes the colour of its logo without any evidence about its conduct.
options.zh: 它改標誌顏色，卻沒有任何行為資料。

options.en: Its staff’s actions under pressure reveal how they treat vulnerable colleagues.
options.zh: 員工在壓力下的行動，顯示如何對待較弱勢同事。

contrast.explanationZh: 標誌配色不代表真實性格；要有行為證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友讀到一則未核實的投訴，就想說公司已顯露真面目。哪句建議最好？

options.en: Check what happened and how it responded before saying it showed its true colours.
options.zh: 說公司顯露真面目前，先查發生甚麼，以及它如何回應。

options.en: Repeat the judgement using only the headline, without checking the response or follow-up.
options.zh: 只按標題重複判斷，不查回應或跟進。

options.en: Use the company’s new logo colours as evidence of how it handled the complaint.
options.zh: 用公司的新標誌配色，證明它如何處理投訴。

dialogue.explanationZh: 這是對行為及態度的評價，需要查事件與回應；標題及配色不足。

speaking.en: The way a company handles a problem can show its true colours.
speaking.zh: 公司處理問題的方式，可顯露真實態度。
speaking.promptZh: 你想把性格判斷連到受考驗時的行為。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：球隊常說支持隊友，但一位隊員失手後，有人公開羞辱他；你想指出這種反應與口號不符。用一至兩句英文描述。

examples.en: Some teammates showed their true colours when they publicly mocked him after the mistake. Their reaction did not match the promise to support one another.
examples.zh: 一些隊友在他失手後公開嘲笑他，顯露了真實態度。他們的反應不符合互相支持的承諾。

examples.en: Those players showed their true colours under pressure, choosing to embarrass a teammate instead of offering the support they had promised.
examples.zh: 那些球員在壓力下顯露真實態度，選擇令隊友難堪，而非提供承諾的支持。

writing.selfCheckZh: 只就題設那些人的具體行為評價，不推成所有隊員永遠如此；保留口號與回應對比。

takeaways.en: A difficult moment can show a team’s true colours.
takeaways.zh: 困難時刻可顯露團隊真實態度。

takeaways.en: They showed their true colours in the way they treated a colleague who needed help.
takeaways.zh: 他們對待需要協助同事的方式，顯露了真實態度。

sources.sentence: The printer started acting up before the meeting.

brief.meaningEn: Fail to work properly or behave unpredictably, used here of equipment.
brief.meaningZh: 運作不正常或不穩定，本課用於器材。
brief.grammar: a device is acting up; started acting up; acted up in the past.
brief.register: Informal phrasal verb; the same wording can refer to a person’s troublesome behaviour, but that is not this lesson’s equipment sense.
brief.boundaryZh: 說明出問題，不提供確切原因；不能把 acting up 當作故障診斷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 仍能偶爾工作，也可叫 acting up；先描述症狀，再檢查安全處理。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然描述不穩定設備，並提出查證或備用安排。

options.en: The printer works unreliably, but the exact cause is not given.
options.zh: 打印機運作不穩定，但沒有交代確切原因。

options.en: The printer has been confirmed to work normally on every page.
options.zh: 已確認打印機每頁都正常運作。

options.en: The sentence identifies the exact part that must be replaced.
options.zh: 句子指出必須更換的確切零件。

options.en: The team has already identified and replaced the faulty part.
options.zh: 團隊已找出並更換有問題的零件。

listening.explanationZh: 半頁停止是症狀，沒有指出零件或確切原因；使用備用機不代表已修好主要那部。
listening.en: The printer is acting up: it sometimes stops halfway through a page, so we are using another one while it is checked.
listening.zh: 打印機運作不正常：有時印到半頁便停，所以檢查期間我們用另一部。

reply.promptEn: Why are you using the spare printer today?
reply.promptZh: 你今天為甚麼用備用打印機？

options.en: The usual printer keeps stopping in the middle of a page.
options.zh: 平常用的打印機不斷印到半頁便停。

options.en: The main printer is acting up and needs checking.
options.zh: 主要打印機運作不正常，需要檢查。

options.en: We cannot rely on the main one to finish the handouts at the moment.
options.zh: 暫時不能靠主要那部完成講義。

options.en: We need a working alternative while the fault is investigated.
options.zh: 調查故障期間，我們需要可正常使用的替代器材。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均合理解釋備用安排；金句說故障現象，不冒充確切診斷。

scene.promptZh: 投影機時好時壞，畫面不時消失，你還不知道原因，先換另一部。哪句最自然？

options.en: The projector is acting up, so we are using a spare.
options.zh: 投影機運作不正常，所以我們用備用機。

options.en: The projector has passed every check and works without interruption.
options.zh: 投影機通過每項檢查，運作沒有中斷。

options.en: The checks have already identified the cable and the projector has been repaired.
options.zh: 檢查已找出有問題的線，投影機也已修好。

scene.explanationZh: 不穩定畫面支持 acting up；題目仍未知原因，不是已修好或一直正常。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 the printer is acting up 判斷？

options.en: The speaker is describing a problem with how the printer works.
options.zh: 說話者正描述打印機運作有問題。

options.en: A named internal component is definitely the cause.
options.zh: 某個指明的內部零件肯定是原因。

options.en: Further checks may be needed to identify the fault.
options.zh: 可能需要進一步檢查，找出故障原因。

contrast.explanationZh: 片語描述異常，不是零件名稱或診斷結果。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說電腦「acting up」，便想未檢查先買昂貴零件。哪句建議較好？

options.en: If it is acting up, describe the symptoms and get it checked before buying a replacement part.
options.zh: 如果運作不正常，先描述症狀及安排檢查，再買替換零件。

options.en: Choose the most expensive component first and look for evidence of the fault afterwards.
options.zh: 先選最貴零件，之後才找故障證據。

options.en: Keep restarting during the presentation without preparing any alternative or reporting the symptoms.
options.zh: 簡報中不斷重開機，卻不準備替代安排或報告症狀。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先把症狀查清，再作適當處理；單靠片語不能決定零件。

speaking.en: The laptop is acting up, so I will describe the symptoms and ask for a check.
speaking.zh: 手提電腦運作不正常，所以我會描述症狀，請人檢查。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述問題，而非先猜確切原因。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：活動音響不時斷聲，尚未查出原因，你打算改用備用喇叭並報告症狀。用一至兩句英文說明。

examples.en: The sound system is acting up and keeps cutting out. We will use the spare speaker while someone checks the fault.
examples.zh: 音響運作不正常，不斷斷聲。有人檢查故障期間，我們會用備用喇叭。

examples.en: Our sound system has been acting up, so we are switching to a spare and reporting the symptoms rather than guessing which part is broken.
examples.zh: 音響一直運作不正常，所以我們改用備用器材，並報告症狀，而非猜哪個零件壞了。

writing.selfCheckZh: 描述斷聲及備用方案，保留原因未知；不把普通故障片語當確切診斷。

takeaways.en: The old printer started acting up during the meeting.
takeaways.zh: 舊打印機在會議期間開始運作不正常。

takeaways.en: If the projector acts up again, we have a spare ready.
takeaways.zh: 如果投影機再出問題，我們已有備用機。

sources.sentence: Customers feel in safe hands with trained staff.

brief.meaningEn: Being cared for or managed by someone reliable and capable.
brief.meaningZh: 由可靠而有能力的人照顧或管理。
brief.grammar: be/feel/leave something in safe hands; explain relevant competence or care.
brief.register: Reassuring idiom; evidence of suitability matters, and it is not a promise of zero risk.
brief.boundaryZh: 不只指有人拿着東西，也不是百分百沒有風險；要與實際能力及安排連繫。
brief.misconceptionZh: 自信聲稱不能代替訓練、程序或適當交接。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以相關能力及交接資料支持安心託付的說法。

listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持安心託付的說法？

options.en: Relevant training and practical preparations support confidence in the coordinator.
options.zh: 相關訓練及實際準備，支持對統籌員的信心。

options.en: Only the equipment has been checked; support for new participants is still unplanned.
options.zh: 只檢查了器材，新參加者的支援仍未安排。

options.en: The workshop no longer needs checks because someone sounds confident.
options.zh: 有人聽來自信，所以工作坊不再需要檢查。

options.en: The new participants have been left to arrange the equipment without support.
options.zh: 新參加者被留下自行安排器材，沒有支援。

listening.explanationZh: 受訓、器材檢查及參加者支援是具體可靠線索；不是只完成器材檢查或免除準備。
listening.en: The workshop is in safe hands with the trained coordinator, who has checked the equipment and arranged support for new participants.
listening.zh: 工作坊由受訓統籌員妥善管理；她已檢查器材，並為新參加者安排支援。

reply.promptEn: Why do you feel comfortable leaving the workshop with this coordinator?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼放心把工作坊交給這位統籌員？

options.en: She has the relevant training and has prepared support for the group.
options.zh: 她有相關訓練，也為小組準備支援。

options.en: The workshop is in safe hands because she knows the equipment and the plan.
options.zh: 她熟悉器材及計劃，所以工作坊有人可靠地管理。

options.en: She has checked the arrangements and knows whom to contact if help is needed.
options.zh: 她已核對安排，也知道需要協助時應聯絡誰。

options.en: Her earlier workshops show careful preparation and responsible follow-up.
options.zh: 她以往工作坊顯示有細心準備及負責跟進。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以相關能力支持信心；金句不等於保證沒有任何問題。

scene.promptZh: 你把社團活動交給受訓同事，對方熟悉參加者需要，也已核對流程。哪句合適？

options.en: The event is in safe hands with this colleague.
options.zh: 活動由這位同事妥善管理。

options.en: No preparation is needed because the colleague has accepted the role.
options.zh: 同事接了職位，所以不用準備。

options.en: The colleague has been left without the information needed to run the event.
options.zh: 同事沒有獲得主持活動所需資料。

scene.explanationZh: 受訓、熟悉需要及核對流程支持可靠管理；不是無需準備或沒有交接。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜只憑 in safe hands 得出？

options.en: The speaker trusts the person’s relevant ability and care.
options.zh: 說話者信任對方的相關能力及細心。

options.en: No difficulty can occur and no further checks will ever be needed.
options.zh: 不可能有困難，也永遠不再需要檢查。

options.en: The phrase can reassure someone about competent management.
options.zh: 片語可讓人對有能力的管理者感到安心。

contrast.explanationZh: 可靠管理仍需持續檢查及應變；安心不等於零風險保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說同事很可靠，便想不交名單及支援聯絡資料就離開活動。哪句建議最好？

options.en: It may be in safe hands, but give your colleague the list and support contacts for a proper handover.
options.zh: 活動可能由可靠的人管理，但仍要把名單及支援聯絡資料交給同事，做好交接。

options.en: Leave now and let the colleague reconstruct the missing contact details during the event.
options.zh: 現在離開，讓同事在活動中重新找齊缺漏聯絡資料。

options.en: Replace the handover notes with a reassuring message about how experienced the colleague is.
options.zh: 以同事多有經驗的安心訊息，取代交接紀錄。

dialogue.explanationZh: 信任能力仍要給必要資料，才能把可靠安排落實；讚美不能取代交接。

speaking.en: The event is in safe hands, and a clear handover will help the coordinator run it well.
speaking.zh: 活動由可靠的人管理，而清楚交接可幫統籌員妥善進行。
speaking.promptZh: 你想讓人安心，同時保留交接責任。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你請受訓導賞員帶學生參觀，她熟悉路線及支援安排；你會先給她最新名單。用一至兩句英文讓同事安心。

examples.en: The students are in safe hands with the trained guide, who knows the route and support arrangements. I will give her the updated list before the visit.
examples.zh: 學生由受訓導賞員妥善照顧；她熟悉路線及支援安排。參觀前，我會給她最新名單。

examples.en: I feel the group is in safe hands because the guide is well prepared, and we will complete the handover before they leave.
examples.zh: 導賞員準備充分，所以我覺得小組有人妥善照顧；出發前我們會完成交接。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把安心連到導賞員能力及準備，保留交名單的下一步；不把安心寫成零風險。

takeaways.en: The project is in safe hands with a capable coordinator and a clear plan.
takeaways.zh: 有能幹統籌員及清楚計劃，項目有人妥善管理。

takeaways.en: I know the group is in safe hands, and I will still provide the information they need.
takeaways.zh: 我知道小組有人妥善照顧，仍會提供所需資料。

brief.meaningEn: Make progress towards a desired or appropriate outcome without necessarily reaching it yet.
brief.meaningZh: 朝理想或合適結果取得進展，但不一定已達目標。
brief.grammar: be moving in the right direction; moved in the right direction after a change; define the goal.
brief.register: Conventional progress metaphor; can acknowledge improvement while identifying work still needed.
brief.boundaryZh: 是進展而非完成，也不保證之後一直改善；要看與目標相關的證據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 較好的一項指標不代表整個問題解決；仍可追蹤其他需要。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體改善描述進展，並保留未完成部分。

options.en: There is encouraging progress, with the target still to be reached.
options.zh: 已有可喜進展，但仍要達到目標。

options.en: The target has already been fully achieved.
options.zh: 目標已完全達到。

options.en: Attendance has become worse since the plan began.
options.zh: 計劃開始後，出席情況惡化。

options.en: The group has abandoned participation as a goal.
options.zh: 小組已放棄參與這個目標。

listening.explanationZh: 缺席減少支持進展；though 明確保留尚未達標。
listening.en: Fewer students are missing the practice sessions, so the plan is moving in the right direction, though participation is not yet at our target.
listening.zh: 缺席練習的學生減少，所以計劃正朝合適方向進展，但參與仍未達目標。

reply.promptEn: How is the plan to improve attendance going?
reply.promptZh: 改善出席的計劃進展怎樣？

options.en: Fewer students are missing sessions, but we have not met the target yet.
options.zh: 缺席學生少了，但還沒達標。

options.en: We are moving in the right direction, with more students attending regularly.
options.zh: 更多學生定期出席，我們正朝合適方向進展。

options.en: The latest attendance figures are better, though some students still need support.
options.zh: 最新出席數字較好，但部分學生仍需支援。

options.en: There has been a useful improvement, and we are checking what still prevents attendance.
options.zh: 已有有用改善，我們也正查還有甚麼妨礙出席。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能報告有進展但未完成的狀況；金句不是結案。

scene.promptZh: 學生新計劃令遲交功課次數下降，但仍有幾次，需要繼續調整。哪句合適？

options.en: The plan is moving in the right direction, but there is more to do.
options.zh: 計劃正朝合適方向進展，但仍有工作要做。

options.en: The improvement shows the problem is already completely solved.
options.zh: 這個改善顯示問題已完全解決。

options.en: The fewer late submissions show the plan has made the situation worse.
options.zh: 遲交減少，顯示計劃令情況惡化。

scene.explanationZh: 遲交減少是朝目標的改善，仍有遲交就不等於完成。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 moving in the right direction 得出？

options.en: There may be evidence of progress towards the goal.
options.zh: 可能有朝目標進展的證據。

options.en: The intended result has necessarily been fully achieved.
options.zh: 預期結果必然已完全達到。

options.en: The speaker may still identify problems that need work.
options.zh: 說話者仍可能指出需要處理的問題。

contrast.explanationZh: 方向合適表示進展，不是必定完成或無需再檢查。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友看到一次改善，就想停止追蹤尚未達標的計劃。哪句較有幫助？

options.en: We are moving in the right direction, but let us track the next few sessions before deciding what support is still needed.
options.zh: 我們正朝合適方向進展，但先追蹤之後幾次，再決定還需要甚麼支援。

options.en: Close the review now and use the improved session as the final result for the whole plan.
options.zh: 現在結束檢討，把改善的一次當作整個計劃最終結果。

options.en: Change the target to the current figure before checking whether the original need has been met.
options.zh: 未查原來需要是否滿足，先把目標改成現時數字。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認改善，同時追蹤未完成需要；結案或單改目標都沒有核實持續進展。

speaking.en: We are moving in the right direction, but we still need to check the results over time.
speaking.zh: 我們正朝合適方向進展，但仍要持續檢查結果。
speaking.promptZh: 你想肯定改善，也保留後續檢查。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校回收計劃令錯放垃圾減少，但仍常有混淆，你想肯定進展並建議繼續改善標示。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The recycling plan is moving in the right direction because fewer items are going into the wrong bins. We should still improve the labels where confusion remains.
examples.zh: 錯放回收桶的物品減少，回收計劃正朝合適方向進展。我們仍應改善還令人混淆的標示。

examples.en: We are moving in the right direction, but some students still mix up the bins, so clearer labels could help the next stage.
examples.zh: 我們正朝合適方向進展，但部分學生仍混淆回收桶，所以更清楚標示可幫助下一階段。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以錯放減少支持進展，保留混淆及標示下一步，不宣稱已全面解決。

takeaways.en: The team is moving in the right direction as its coordination improves.
takeaways.zh: 合作漸有改善，團隊正朝合適方向進展。

takeaways.en: The results moved in the right direction, though further changes were needed.
takeaways.zh: 結果朝合適方向進展，但仍需要進一步改變。
